description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of the access layer
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-controller-detection --db-cluster-id amv-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2022-03-10T23:56Z --end-time 2024-06-23T02:21Z --lang zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeControllerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

> 

*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> * 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ* format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the **yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ** format. The time must be in UTC.

>  The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be specified is 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
日志的结束时间。格式：**yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ**（UTC时间）。

> 查询日志时，结束时间需大于开始时间，且与开始时间最大间隔不超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

*   **zh**: simplified Chinese.
*   **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
- **zh**：简体中文（默认语言）。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang
